title: Keto Kicked Kenyan Fatty Food Bake
description: A rich, keto-friendly Kenyan dish featuring a fluffy air-fried crust and a sweet, rum-infused sauce. Serve warm for an indulgent treat.

ingredients.name: Dark Rum
ingredients.notes: Do not omit, as this gives the dish its unique flavor.

ingredients.name: Palm Sugar
ingredients.notes: Substitute with granulated sugar if desired.

ingredients.name: Coconut Cream
ingredients.notes: Chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour before use.

ingredients.name: Sausage Meat
ingredients.notes: Use a low-carb sausage for keto compliance.

instructions: Combine pork rind crust mix, dark rum, and coconut cream in a bowl. Mix well to form a sticky dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes to create a smooth crust texture.
Shape the dough into a flat circle, about 1 inch (2.5 cm) thick.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the sausage meat and cook until browned, breaking into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the palm sugar and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Transfer the skillet contents to a baking dish and add the eggs. Mix well to create a creamy sauce.
Add the cayenne pepper and salt, and mix again.
Transfer the dough to the air fryer basket and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the dish from the air fryer and top with the sauce. Serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
